home.title: Scriptures of Yahuah
home.subtitle: Read and understand the Word of the Most High with original restored names.
home.votd_text: For Elohim so loved the world that He gave His only brought-forth Son, so that everyone who believes in Him should not perish but possess everlasting life.
home.intro_heading: The Word of the Most High
home.intro_body: These are the Scriptures of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 — preserved, restored, and made available to all people. Read with the original Hebrew names as they were first written: Yahuah instead of ‘LORD’, Yahusha instead of ‘Jesus’, Mosheh instead of ‘Moses’. This collection includes the Torah, the Prophets, the Writings, and many extra-canonical books — 101 books in total.
home.path_heading: Where would you like to begin?
home.path_new_desc: Start from the beginning. Learn who Yahuah is, understand the restored names, and find a gentle reading path.
home.path_familiar_desc: Familiar with Scripture but new to the restored names? Discover what changed, and why the original names matter.
home.path_deep_desc: Search across all 101 books by name, topic, or verse. Read extra-canonical writings alongside the canon.
home.guide_body: New to these Scriptures? Begin with Bereshit (Genesis) to understand creation and the covenant, then Shemoth (Exodus) for the Torah and the Name. Move to the Psalms for prayer and praise, then the Gospels — start with Mattithyahu (Matthew). For deeper study, Ḥanoḵ (Enoch) and Yubilees (Jubilees) illuminate much of what the other books reference.
